HBIM_Inscription.Text_EN:
A great god is Ahuramazda, who created this earth, who created that heaven, who created humankind, who created well‑being for humankind, who made me, Artaxerxes, king — one man as king over many, one man as lord over many.

Thus speaks Artaxerxes, the Great King, King of Kings, King of Lands, King of this earth: I am the son of King Artaxerxes (II); Artaxerxes was the son of King Darius (II); Darius was the son of King Artaxerxes (I); Artaxerxes was the son of King Xerxes; Xerxes was the son of King Darius (I); Darius was the son of one Hystaspes; Hystaspes was the son of one Arsames — an Achaemenid.

Thus says King Artaxerxes: This stone terrace has been built by me for myself.

Thus says King Artaxerxes: May Ahuramazda and the god Mithra protect me, and this land, and what has been built by me.
